children: Harvard Apparatus Regenerative Technology completed a private placement of 2,703,727 common shares at $1.05 per share, raising approximately $2.84 million on September 11, 2026. The offering, conducted under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506, enhances the company’s liquidity. In a concurrent transaction, CEO Jerry (Junli) He converted and canceled $717,911 of bridge promissory notes and accrued interest into 683,725 shares at the same price, reducing debt and further aligning management with shareholders.
